headline: Nigerian Breweries Contributed N1.6 Trillion to GDP in 2025, CEO Says
summary: Nigerian Breweries Plc stated that its manufacturing and distribution operations contributed N1.6 trillion to Nigeria’s gross domestic product in 2025.
why: Nigerian Breweries is one of Nigeria's largest non-oil consumer goods manufacturers listed on the Nigerian Exchange.

impacts.name: Nigerian Breweries
impacts.why: Company announced its total economic GDP footprint.
